Skip the four POSIX-only doctests on Windows, by name, with a guard (#5) (#7)

* Skip the four POSIX-only doctests on Windows, by name, with a guard (#5) [run ci]

They wrap real PATH commands (pwd, ls) or a /bin/bash script, which
windows-latest lacks. A root conftest skips exactly those four there; a test
fails if a listed name stops matching a doctest.
